description: Defines the EntryImpl class for cache entry management in disk cache, including data operations, state management, and logging.

classes.name: EntryImpl
classes.description: Represents a cache entry with data read/write operations, state management, and logging capabilities.

methods.name: DoomImpl
methods.description: Performs internal logic to mark the entry as doomed.

methods.name: ReadDataImpl
methods.description: Implements reading data from the cache entry.

methods.name: WriteDataImpl
methods.description: Implements writing data to the cache entry.

methods.name: ReadyForSparseIOImpl
methods.description: Prepares the entry for sparse IO.

methods.name: CreateEntry
methods.description: Initializes the cache entry with key and address.

methods.name: IsSameEntry
methods.description: Checks if the entry matches given key and hash.

methods.name: GetNextAddress
methods.description: Returns address of next entry with same hash.

methods.name: SetNextAddress
methods.description: Sets address of next entry with same hash.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates runtime info of the entry.

methods.name: LeaveRankingsBehind
methods.description: Checks if rankings can be left behind.

methods.name: SetTimes
methods.description: Sets last used and modified times.

methods.name: NumBlocksForEntry
methods.description: Calculates blocks needed for an entry.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Public interface to doom the entry.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key of the entry.

methods.name: GetDataSize
methods.description: Returns size of data at index.

methods.name: CouldBeSparse
methods.description: Checks if entry could be sparse.

methods.name: SetLastUsedTimeForTest
methods.description: Sets last used time for testing.
